column1: # Models fetched on demand by `make models`.
# Columns, tab separated: filename, url, sha256 of the file's bytes.
# Note that the sha256 here is of the file itself, which is not the SHA the
# GitHub API reports for a blob: that one is sha1("blob <len>\0" + content).
# Comparing against the wrong hash will fail every time.
# Fetched models are gitignored. The Stanford-derived ones are research and
# non-commercial use only, with attribution to the Stanford Computer Graphics
# Laboratory, so this repository links to them rather than redistributing them.
# Sources are pinned to a commit of alecjacobson/common-3d-test-models, which
# carries the classic test models already converted to OBJ.
